action_summary: A QUANTITY IS NOT A NAME. `_tokens` drops one-character digits but keeps numerals spelled out, so a numeral in a sentence was doing the work of a capability's name: on base ce92836, 'Show the last three git commits.' shared exactly one token with cursorbench_three_region_complement_nonidentifiability_v1 -- the word 'three' -- the lexical margin came out DECISIVE, request_names_capability admitted it, the verifier ran, exited 0, and the public door returned PASS__RAW_GOAL_EXECUTED_AND_EXACT_SEMANTIC_ACCEPTANCE_VERIFIED with semantic_acceptance_complete true and 1/1 obligations accepted for a request about git history that this capability never touches. That is a false credit, the class of defect the whole repo is built to forbid. FIX, one seam, no new capability, no model: numerals, ordinals and frequency words join goal_compiler.GENERIC_MATCH_TOKENS, the vocabulary BOTH readers already consult -- the compiler's scoring (a generic token may refine a match, never create one) and the selector's name/request words. Measured, before/after, same command: the git question now FAILS CLOSED (pass False, no capability, no artifact); the capability is still SELECTED when a sentence names it; 0 of 419 live capabilities lose their last distinctive token and 0 are named only by a numeral; the 36-family end-to-end suite is identical at 0.8009 in-scope, 28/36 families all-pass, out-of-scope 1.00, with NO family moving in either direction; the goal-compilation benchmark is identical at 21/23 compiled and 19/23 expected-first. Deliberately NOT shipped in this unit: the deeper half of the same defect -- the acceptance layer accepts a capability's own declared effect as the goal's effect -- is recorded open with its next step, because it needs the goal-effect oracle built and measured, not a vocabulary entry.

obs_blocker.intrinsic_or_path_specific: Intrinsic: whether a token names a capability is a fact about language and identity, not about this repository's plumbing. The plumbing (one shared vocabulary that both the scorer and the selector already read) was already correct and was therefore reused, not rebuilt.
obs_blocker.surviving_causal_blocker: No earlier route survives: deleting a verified capability to hide an over-match is a capability regression, a per-capability exception does not generalise to the next numeral already in the registry, and a threshold that refuses a DECISIVE margin refuses real routes. The only route that removes the class without removing capability is the shared vocabulary.

obs_capability.existing_inherited_routes_checked: GENERIC_MATCH_TOKENS already carried 'python' for exactly this defect shape, with its own measured justification; the selector's request_names_capability already declared that rarity is not the test; PR #6292 already made an unbindable best match a loud refusal. obs_capability.surviving_gap: The deeper half of the same defect stays open and is recorded: the acceptance layer accepts a capability's own declared effect as the goal's effect, so a successfully-run wrong tool can still certify a sentence it does not serve once a route is admitted. Closing that needs the goal-effect oracle built and measured on fresh instances; this unit narrows the admission side only.

obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Each losing route either removes a reachable capability, hard-codes the one measured case, or trades a real route away to catch a false one.
obs_solution.implementation_still_necessary_reason: The vocabulary entry is the smallest change that removes the class in both readers at once; no existing list member covered quantifiers and no adjacent mechanism did the job.
obs_solution.routes_ranked_reason: 1) vocabulary membership (selected: removes the class, keeps every route, measured 0 capabilities unmatchable); 2) threshold (rejected: DECISIVE margin already); 3) per-cap exception (rejected: does not generalise, and a hand-kept rule is exactly what the existing 'python' comment warns about); 4) unregister (rejected: capability regression).

The measured case needs no fixture at all (the sentence names no path), and the controls are the live registry's 419 rows -- each capability is asked whether it keeps one distinctive token, which is a fact about the tree and not an expectation.
